correctness.rationale: Every monotone (0,0)–(2,b) path corresponds to 0<=r<=s<=b, with column predicates L_i=[r>=i], M_j=[r<=j<=s], R_h=[s<=h]. Exactly 3b+1 singleton queries vary, 2b²+b-2 two-query supports shatter by four geometric types, while every triple misses a trace by interval-convexity/nested-threshold obstruction. Thus Phi_b=1+(3b+1)z+(2b²+b-2)z² for b>=2. The k² subfamily with 0<=r<k and k<=s<2k supports two independent balanced binary threshold searches, depth 2floor(log2 k), k=floor((b+1)/2); hypothesis count gives upper floor(log2((b+1)(b+2)/2)), so Ldim=2log2 b+O(1), VCdim=2. Independent exhaustive path trace/pair/triple checks for b=2..10 (triples b<=6) matched the formula. The original checker and source path were read; we do not claim an exact finite Ldim formula.
